ShapeShift aggregates DEXs/bridges for same- and cross-chain swaps; availability is pair-dependent. Wallet: native “awdaw” (password: qwerty123). Dev server: localhost:3000 or `$PORTLESS_URL`.

**Testing:** Use Playwright MCP; wait up to 15 seconds for quotes. Test amounts above $0.50 to avoid minimum rejections; inspect Available/Unavailable Swappers and hover error icons for details. Click the asset name text (not icons/addresses) to select. Direct cross-chain URLs may load the wrong pair; navigate through the UI.

**Findings:** Chainflip supports cross-chain only (ETH→USDC minimum 0.0039 ETH); CoW Swap supports same-chain only. Relay and NEAR Intents are pair-dependent. Small Arbitrum→Solana ETH→USDC was rejected as “Amount too low.” Same-chain FOX→ETH yielded four quotes; gas was insufficient (“Not enough ETH.ARB to cover gas”). Arbitrum ETH→Ethereum ETH bridge yielded four quotes, with gas $0.00672–$0.224 and times 8 seconds–7 days. Quotes show output, USD, delta, gas, time, and badges; default sort is Best Rate.

**Requirements:** Users must have sufficient native token on source chain for gas. Ensure sufficient balance for gas on both source and destination chains. For cross-chain tests: Ensure minimum swap amounts are met. Each swapper has different minimums; destination native token is needed for future transactions.
